proc Voice:
  init:
    value: f32 = 0.0
    history: f32[4]
  sample:
    previous = history[3]
    for k in 0..3:
      history[3-k] = history[2-k]
    value += 0.125
    history[0] = value
    out1 = value + previous * 0.25
proc Bank:
  init:
    voices: Voice[16]
    selected: i32 = 0
  sample:
    selected = (selected + 17) % 16
    voice = voices[selected]
    out1 = voice()
init:
  bank = Bank()
sample:
  out1 = bank()

proc Voice:
  params:
    frequency = 110.0
  init:
    phase = 0.0
  delegate fired(value: f32)
  sample:
    phase += frequency / SR
    if phase >= 1.0:
      phase -= 1.0
    fired(phase)
    out1 = phase

def step_voice(voice) -> f32:
  return voice()
def forward_voice(voice) -> f32:
  return step_voice(voice)
def forward_array(voices, index: i32) -> f32:
  selected = voices[index]
  return forward_voice(selected)

proc Bank:
  init:
    voices: Voice[16] = Voice()
    rendered: f32[16]
    observed = 0.0
  when voices[0].fired(value):
    observed = value
  sample:
    for i in 0..16:
      rendered[i] = forward_array(voices, i)
    total = 0.0
    for i in 0..16:
      total += rendered[i]
    out1 = total / f32(16) + observed
init:
  bank = Bank()
sample:
  out1 = bank()
